label: Single-channel MEMS variable optical attenuator, 0-30dB, LC/UPC
description: Single-channel MEMS variable optical attenuator plug-in card with 0-30 dB continuously adjustable attenuation in 0.1 dB steps, LC/UPC in and out ports, for padding a DWDM span so a receiver sits in its window without touching the amplifier gain. Self insertion loss <=1.5 dB at 0 dB setting, return loss >=50 dB, isolation >=30 dB, wavelength range 1290-1330 / 1525-1568 nm; the card itself is controlled from the managed chassis.
